site.title: Muntaha
site.description: Muntaha Rahman (Moon) — painter and photographer working in oil and light. Originals and prints by inquiry.

about.title: About
paragraphs: I'm a Bengali artist whose work is shaped by memory, family, and the search for self. Growing up in a crowded home taught me how much privacy, independence, and self-expression can mean. My paintings often reflect the quiet emotional weight of ordinary objects and spaces, turning personal history into images of identity, belonging, and freedom.
